shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app current ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- traps ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- installed pc ---\\n' && node -e \"try{console.log(require('@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json'))}catch(e){console.log('ABSENT')}\" && printf '\\n--- docs index ---\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor -maxdepth 3 -iname '*doc*' -o -iname 'README.md' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor@latest version peerDependencies dependencies --json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor@''^8.24.0 @diplodoc/transform@''^4.28.2'

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor -maxdepth 3 -type f \\( -name 'README.md' -o -name 'INDEX.md' \\) -print; printf '\\n--- package exports/version ---\\n'; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json'); console.log(p.version); console.log(JSON.stringify({main:p.main,module:p.module,types:p.types,exports:p.exports},null,2))\""

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- README setup ---\\n'; rg -n -C 8 \"Required setup|PageConstructorProvider|PageConstructor|style|css\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '120,260p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- block docs ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,160p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'for f in blocks/Header.md blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md blocks/Banner.md; do echo "--- $f ---"; cat "node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "cat vite.config.ts; printf '\\n--- current entries ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx src/App.tsx index.html; printf '\\n--- PC block exports/types ---\\n'; rg -n \"header-block|extended-features|banner-block\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/blocks node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm | head -80; printf '\\n--- provider styles setup source ---\\n'; rg -n -C 3 \"styles.scss|PageConstructorProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install -D vite-plugin-dynamic-import sass'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import/package.json'); console.log(p.version, p.main, p.module, JSON.stringify(p.exports, null, 2))\"; rg -n \"dynamicImport|dynamic-import\" node_modules/vite-plugin-dynamic-import -g '*.md' | head -30; printf '\\n--- page constructor component types ---\\n'; rg -n \"export .*PageConstructor|export .*PageConstructorProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/PageConstructor* -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"interface PageContentProps|type PageContent|interface PageContent\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; rg -n -C 4 \"type PageContent\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models -g '*.d.ts'; printf '\\n--- button types ---\\n'; rg -n -C 3 \"interface ButtonProps|type ButtonProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor.d.ts; sed -n '165,205p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md"
/bin/bash -lc "command -v apply_patch || true; find / -type f -name 'apply_patch' -perm -111 2>/dev/null | head -10; git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "npm install -D vite-plugin-node-polyfills && node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/vite-plugin-node-polyfills/package.json'); console.log(p.version); console.log(p.exports)\""
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js; rg -n "nodePolyfills" node_modules/vite-plugin-node-polyfills/README.md | head -20'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install -D @types/node@''^18 && npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json; rg -n '\"types\"|\"lib\"' tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -la node_modules/@types/node/package.json; node -e \"console.log(require('./node_modules/@types/node/package.json').version, JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@types/node/types.d.json')))\" 2>/dev/null || true; npx tsc --version"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- src/App.tsx src/App.css src/main.tsx vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json; git status --short; sed -n '1,120p' src/App.tsx; sed -n '1,80p' vite.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "header-block|extended-features-block|banner-block|PageConstructorProvider|page-constructor/styles|node-url-shim|resolve:|header-block" src/App.tsx src/main.tsx vite.config.ts src/node-url-shim.ts'
